Duluti Lake View Lodge

30-second ad · Arusha, Tanzania

Goal: make viewers want to spend the night at the lodge before and after their safari.

Story: fly in → lodge (rest before safari) → short safari burst → back to the lodge (unwind after) → contact.

Viki in every shot. No voice-over, no on-screen taglines. Music in the background, contact details on the end card only.

Not to be confused with Lake Duluti Lodge (the coffee-farm lodge), a different property on the same lake. Its contacts must not appear in this ad.

Shots

13 s

Plane window

0:00 – 0:03

Commercial airliner, window seat. Viki in the day safari outfit looks out of a standard cabin window. Over her shoulder, Kilimanjaro's snow cap rises above the clouds in morning light.

23 s

Arrival at the lodge

0:03 – 0:06

Over Viki's shoulder in the open safari jeep, rolling along a green tree-lined dirt road. The jeep slows at the lodge's entrance wall: a fence of wooden poles with painted green leaves on top, white letters DULUTI ~ LAKE ~ VIEW LODGE, purple canoes and painted fish below.

33 s

Morning coffee

0:06 – 0:09

Restaurant terrace on the edge of the crater lake. A waitress sets a cup of coffee in front of Viki; she lifts it and looks out over the calm green water.

43 s

Canoe

0:09 – 0:12

Viki paddles a canoe on Lake Duluti. Birds skim the water, forested crater walls, Mount Meru rising behind. Warm sunlight.

53 s

Safari

0:12 – 0:15

Serengeti. Viki stands up in the open safari jeep with binoculars, scarf moving in the wind. Zebra and giraffe close by.

62 s

Safari wide

0:15 – 0:17

High wide shot: the open jeep crossing the golden plain trailing dust, animals all around, a hot air balloon low in the sky behind. Viki small in the jeep.

73 s

Back to the lake

0:17 – 0:20

Drone sweeps over Lake Duluti and the forest, Mount Meru behind, late golden light. Viki small below, walking along the shore toward the trees.

83 s

Tree path

0:20 – 0:23

Back shot: Viki walks the narrow tree-lined path toward her chalet, the lake glinting through the trees on the right.

93 s

Sunset on the deck

0:23 – 0:26

Viki in the evening dress on her chalet deck, glass of red wine, watching the sun go down. Sky gold and orange, the forest darkening.

104 s

End card

0:26 – 0:30

Hold on the sunset (Viki soft in frame or the empty deck). Contact only, two lines:

Duluti Lake View Lodge · Arusha, Tanzania
[website or booking link] · [phone / WhatsApp]

Contacts still to get from the lodge. Prefer website (or Booking.com page) + WhatsApp number.

Music

Track: Nakungoja Daima (remastered, 3:23), African ambient sung in Swahili.

  • 0:00 – 0:26 of the ad: song from 0:04 (the song's own gentle start).
  • 0:26 – 0:30: crossfade into the song's ending fade (from about 3:10), so the music ends on the end card.
  • If "Nakungoja ziwani, nakungoja daima" ("I wait for you by the lake, I wait for you forever") is clearly sung, place it on shots 9–10.
  • Under the music, quiet natural sound: plane hum, birds at the lake, paddle in water, wind on the plain.
